root: Hirz — an arrangement made for the custody of property (s. 2(d))
rootSub: theft liable to hadd must be committed from a hirz (s. 5)

children.title: Hirz by place (bil-makan)
bullets: A house — door open or shut
An almirah, box or other container

children.title: Hirz by guard (bil-hafiz)
bullets: Property in the custody of a person

children.title: One or many?
bullets: One family in a house — one hirz
Several families — each portion a separate hirz
Values from separate hirz are not added (s. 6)

children.title: No hadd because of access
bullets: Servant from master's hirz he may enter (s. 10(c))

children.title: Several thieves
bullets: Hadd on all who entered the hirz (s. 8)

title: Theft liable to hadd — proof and implementation

steps.title: Trial by the Court of Session
steps.text: Not a s. 30 Magistrate; tehsil headquarters; Muslim presiding officer

steps.title: Strict proof
steps.text: Plea of guilty, or two Muslim adult male eye-witnesses (not the victim) after tazkiyah; victim's statement first

steps.title: Sentence
steps.text: Right hand at the wrist; second time left foot at the ankle; third time life

steps.title: Appeal and confirmation by the FSC
steps.text: Not executed until confirmed; meanwhile simple imprisonment; no remission or commutation

steps.title: Execution by the authorised medical officer
steps.text: Postponed if amputation may cause death; not enforced on retraction, witness resiling, victim withdrawing, limbs missing
